headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI initiatives.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit YoY revenue growth. TCS and Wipro maintained strong operating margins above 20% and 16% respectively. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver, while several peers have yet to release results. Guidance was introduced by Wipro, and AI revenue now exceeds 10% of total for TCS.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue is crossing 10% of total for TCS and is a highlighted growth driver for HCLTech, LTM and Wipro.

leaders.why: Strong YoY revenue rise of 20% and solid dividend

laggards.why: Lowest YoY revenue growth among reporting peers at 11.5%
Revenue growth slowed to 15.4% YoY despite large scale
